meaning: SecuritiesOrder connects account, security, trade and pricing. Two distinct unlabelled lines connect SecuritiesOrder and SecuritiesPricing; both are retained. SecuritiesFinancing connects SecuritiesTrade with both an unlabelled association and a hollow-triangle generalization, and connects pricing with multiplicity * at the financing end. Trade connects execution (RelatedTrade, multiplicity 1 at the trade end), pricing, identification, status and security. Settlement connects execution and security. Account and pricing also connect security. Status connects status reason. Security–SecuritiesTax is labelled Security (0..1 at the security end) and TaxDetails (* at the tax end). No other unprinted multiplicity is inferred. The figure establishes entity associations, not an ordered message flow.
multiplicity_note: All printed endpoint multiplicities are retained: 1 at SecuritiesTrade on the execution association; * at SecuritiesFinancing on its pricing association; 0..1 at Security and * at SecuritiesTax. Blank ends mean no multiplicity is printed, not a default cardinality.
package_note: The source prints no package names or enclosing package boundaries, so the reconstruction adds none.

visual_review.method: Compared all 12 entities, 20 relationship lines, hollow-triangle generalization, four printed multiplicity labels, literal association names and absence of package boundaries with original artwork. Traced both unlabelled Order–Pricing lines and distinct Financing–Trade association/generalization. Used top-to-bottom layout to keep cardinalities adjacent to the correct links; visually compared final rendered PNG and original enlarged source.
